title: HUL shares slide 5% after weaker-than-expected Q1; PAT dips 3% to Rs 2,673 crore on one-time credit

Despite the profit decline, the FMCG major posted double-digit revenue growth, driven by broad-based volume and pricing gains, and maintained its margin outlook for FY27.
